Sonatina vendors Sony's AOSP LDAC encoder library (platform/external/libldac)
under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see LICENSE and NOTICE in this directory).

Upstream repository:
  https://android.googlesource.com/platform/external/libldac

Retained / minimally adapted files (built with -D_32BIT_FIXED_POINT for integer-only DSP):
- inc/ldacBT.h            (verbatim)
- src/struct_ldac.h       (SONATINA_KERNEL portable.h pool/memory shims, MSVC UNUSED_ATTR, _32BIT_FIXED_POINT scalar guard)
- src/ldacBT_internal.h   (SONATINA_KERNEL portable.h shim, guard <unistd.h> on _WIN32)
- src/ldacBT_internal.c   (_WIN32 little-endian guard, uint32_t copy in F32 deinterleave)
- All other src/*.c/*.h   (verbatim)
